_scenario: D — OAuth near-expiry (Humanity v1 password-grant access token)
_note: Humanity v1 uses OAuth 2.0 Resource Owner Password Credentials grant (per api_consumed.md). The token endpoint returns access_token + refresh_token + expires_in. This fixture captures the near-expiry shape: expires_in below the framework's refresh threshold (300s). Per live_verification_checklist.md: 'Humanity v1's password-grant access tokens are long-lived; the framework's refresh cron is not exercised for this vendor at V1' — but the framework MUST still react to a vendor returning a short-lived token by triggering refresh on the next call.
